# Going alike, and constancy up to the net's end

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`going-alike-up-to-the-nets-end` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](going-alike-up-to-the-nets-end.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With the successor fixed where a class leads, constancy up to the net's end is going alike with it decided whether the next conditions anything; constancy is constancy up to the net's end with a next. A law's step cut where it cannot go on has a fixed successor and lines ending where the net ends.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With the successor fixed where the class leads (an occurrence alike to another conditions at most one), constancy up to the net's end gives going alike; going alike, where it is decided of whatever the class leads to from an occurrence that conditions something whether it conditions anything, gives constancy up to the net's end, which decides that. So, the successor fixed, it is going alike with that decided. (`Becoming.«至终有常局定后则同行»`, `Becoming.«同行可决则至终有常»`, `Becoming.«至终有常则可决»`, `Becoming.«局定后则至终有常当且仅当同行可决»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. With no premise, a class is constant exactly where it is constant up to the net's end and, wherever an occurrence that conditions something is alike to another, that other conditions something too. (`Becoming.«至终有常可续则有常»`, `Becoming.«有常当且仅当至终有常可续»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. The fixed successor cannot be dropped: where 0 conditions 1 and 2 and the class holds each occurrence alike only to itself, the class is constant up to the net's end and does not go alike. (`Becoming.«后不定则至终有常可不同行»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. A law's step cut where it cannot go on relates a configuration to the one after it where it can go on, and to nothing where it cannot. It lies within the whole step, is the whole step where it can always go on, has a fixed successor, and a step of it that continues under a class is a step of the whole step that continues under that class met with being able to go on. (`Becoming.Law.stepWhile`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_step`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_always`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_fixed`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_continues_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
5. On the cut step a configuration conditions nothing exactly where it cannot go on, and has a successor in a line under a class exactly where it can go on and is alike to the one after it; n steps from s lead to t exactly where it can go on at the first n configurations of the orbit and t is the orbit's at n; under the one, the line from s never ends exactly where it can go on along the whole orbit. (`Becoming.Law.stepWhile_none_iff`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_hasSucc_iff`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_steps_iff`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_unending_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. On the cut step a value class goes alike exactly where two configurations of one value that can both go on lead to configurations of one value, and is constant exactly where, of two of one value, if the first can go on the second can too and they lead to one value. For any class, where being able to go on is decided at every configuration, constancy up to the net's end is going alike. (`Becoming.Law.stepWhile_goesAlike_iff`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_constant_iff`, `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_toEnd_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. That being able to go on be decided cannot be dropped: on two configurations each left where it is, one always able to go on and one able exactly where a proposition P holds, the cut step goes alike under the one, and its constancy up to the net's end would decide P. (`Becoming.Law.stepWhile_toEnd_decides`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. From a configuration that can go on, the package's guarded history of the law under one disturbance, which asks its guard at both ends of a step, is at n the orbit's configuration exactly where n steps of the cut step lead there and it can go on there. (`Becoming.Law.stepWhile_guarded_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Any type of occurrences, any relation read as 缘 and any class; the cut step for any function giving the configuration after a step and any predicate saying where it can go on.
- For going alike from constancy up to the net's end: the successor fixed where the class leads. For the converse: decided, of whatever the class leads to from an occurrence that conditions something, whether it conditions anything.
- For the cut step's constancy up to the net's end as going alike: whether a configuration can go on decided at every configuration, a premise and not taken from excluded middle.
- For the tie to the guarded history: a decidable predicate, a start that can go on, and the law read as a law of change under one disturbance (Lasting.determined).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That going alike gives constancy up to the net's end on a cut step where being able to go on is undecided: there it would decide a proposition. Witness: `Becoming.Law.stepWhile_toEnd_decides`.
- That constancy up to the net's end gives going alike where the successor is not fixed. Witness: `Becoming.«后不定则至终有常可不同行»`.
- That GrammarLaws' law joining constancy with going alike and a next is proved from these: it follows from them by an argument stated in the module's header, and its proof there is its own.
- That the cut step is the package's guarded law: that law asks its guard at both ends of a step, and the two are tied only from a configuration that can go on.
- That any actual process has a step cut where it cannot go on, or where: the cut and its predicate are given.
- **Counterexample:** Against going alike from constancy up to the net's end with any successor: where 0 conditions 1 and 2 and the class is the identity, the class is constant up to the net's end and does not go alike («后不定则至终有常可不同行»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarPath.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Against dropping the decision: on two truth values each left where it is, true always able to go on and false exactly where P holds, the cut step goes alike under the one and its constancy up to the net's end decides P (Law.stepWhile_toEnd_decides). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GuardedStep.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

## Evidence

Pure core, axiom reports empty. Seven short laws and header sentences added to GrammarPath after «有常则至终有常», nothing else changed, and a module of one definition and thirteen laws, near-definitional; the two witnesses computed on two and three occurrences. Written by AI agents: implemented in two rounds, with last fixes by the coordinating session, and read cold for statements, duplicates and conformance by five AI agents in two rounds and by the coordinating session; no human audit yet.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (AI-written, from its knowledge): the root's two names for one gap become one where each occurrence has at most one next, as in a determined law, and the gap opens only where a step can be missing. A law cut where it cannot go on is the form of a process that stops when a condition fails, a guard read at the start of each step.
